limitations: No market census, whole-market recall, executable outcome, holdings-protection or profitability is established by this candidate-only analysis.
Periodic snapshots may miss compaction peaks and candidates retired between snapshots; a zero sampled compaction count is unavailable evidence, not proof compaction did not run.
Raw complete feature endpoints can lack context warming, audit, current generation or deadlines. They are not automatically valid strategy evaluations.
Absence of a failure is only evidence for the observed arrivals/concurrency/activity; it does not prove six busy pools if fewer were observed.
History signatures include non-swap and failed pool-address transactions. Required count is not trade count; provider message count is not event completeness.
Late information and cancellation stay at recorded availability time; logical cancellation never asserts physical request settlement.
